name: Monica Albright
original_name: モニカ・オルブライト
source:
A childhood friend who lived next door to Ryle. Together they discovered her potential as a hunter. Ryle's quarrel buddy who is like a family to her. She is active, open-minded and usually kind, but her shortcoming is that she can be a bit quick to anger.

She grew up with her mother, but she passed away a few years ago due to an injury. Since then, she has been living alone, working various part-time jobs such as a maid and waitress. Although she acts normal, Ryle was her only source of comfort.

Her specialty is white magic. She and Gilbert, who also teaches white magic, are father and daughter, but they are currently in a quarrel but it seems only on Monica sided.
